revenue from contracts with customers.description: Income arising in the course of an entity's ordinary activities, recognized when performance obligations are satisfied by transferring promised goods or services to customers.

valuation allowance for deferred tax ass.canonical: Valuation Allowance for Deferred Tax Assets
